messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate detected on dedicated cluster corsair-eu-1 (customer: Corsair Inc). Spike in 503 responses for /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Paging @ryan_oncall :rotating_light:
ryan_oncall: Ack, on it. I'm seeing the same in dashboards. Starting investigation — will attempt a graceful restart of the affected serving shard and consider routing to fallback.
emily_sre: Confirmed repeated OOMs on gpu-7-12 serving shard-3. Kicking restart of the process on that node. ETA ~8m.
olivia_eng: Throttling new sessions at edge-router for corsair-eu-1 and applying a temporary route policy to send enterprise-tier -> dedicated-fallback-2. Command: ```sh
rb-route set --cluster corsair-eu-1 --route enterprise --fallback dedicated-fallback-2
```
pete_ops: Infra asked to spin up spare node in eu-west-1; enabling emergency burst capacity (policy id: burst-2026-03). ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
laura_csm: Quick heads-up — impacted enterprise accounts on this pool: Corsair Inc (priority), Meridian Financial, Halcyon Health. Need a tailored impact blurb for each and who will send notices to their contacts.
juan_support: I can handle outbound notices once we have an impact statement. Please include: start time, affected endpoints, mitigation, and whether retries succeed. Also list CSM + support escalation contacts.
ryan_oncall: Start time ~4698765400 (approx). Impact: intermittent 503 errors for generate/chat; some retries succeed. No evidence of data loss. Mitigation steps: node restart, routing to fallback, burst capacity enabled. Drafting status page blurb now.
ryan_oncall: ```status page draft:
We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text-generation and chat endpoints in the EU Dedicated cluster serving several enterprise customers (Corsair Inc, Meridian Financial, Halcyon Health). A subset of requests are returning 503 errors. Engineers are restarting affected serving nodes and routing traffic to fallback capacity. We expect partial recovery within 15 minutes. No customer data integrity impact identified. Updates every 15 minutes.
```
laura_csm: Draft looks good. For customer notices: Corsair needs a tailored statement mentioning transaction-level failures for their user-facing chat assistant. Meridian wants an engineering summary only (no customer-facing blurb). Halcyon prefers phone notification + email. I'll queue messages.
ryan_oncall: Corsair tailored notice (draft): ```We experienced intermittent 503 errors for Corsair Inc between HH:MM–HH:MM UTC, affecting generation and chat APIs. Engineers routed traffic to fallback capacity and restarted affected nodes; most traffic has recovered. No data loss. Our on-call will follow up with a timeline and RCA.``` Approve to send? :eyes:
emily_sre: Restart completed — gpu-7-12 serving process is back online. Error rate is trending down to baseline. Monitoring for 10m to confirm stability. :white_check_mark:
pete_ops: Burst capacity is active and accepted connections are stable. No additional scaling errors.
laura_csm: Sending Corsair notice to primary distro and their CSM pager now. Meridian + Halcyon messages queued pending final confirmation.
juan_support: Sent acknowledgement to Corsair contacts with the draft above and an escalation phone number. Will attach final timeline and RCA when available.
ryan_oncall: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4698765432 (placeholder). Will post next update in 10m or on any change.
incident-bot: Auto-check: error-rate back within normal bounds for 5m. Suggest marking incident RESOLVED if no regression.
emily_sre: Confirming stable for 10m — resolving. I'll open a post-incident with root cause: regression in batch sizing logic causing increased memory pressure -> OOM on specific shard; include customer impact table and contact routing timeline.
laura_csm: Thanks — Corsair confirmed reduced errors and appreciated the quick notice. Closing handoff. Please add the list of recipients and timestamps to the postmortem so we can reconcile customer comms. :white_check_mark:
